description: This file provides the implementation of the Ginkgo testing framework's interface for integrating with Go's testing package, including functions like GinkgoT() and GinkgoTB(), and related interface and wrapper types.

classes.name: GinkgoTBWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper struct that implements the testing.TB interface and embeds a FullGinkgoTInterface for deeper Ginkgo integration.

methods.name: GinkgoT
methods.description: Returns an interface similar to *testing.T, allowing third-party libraries to integrate with Ginkgo.

methods.name: GinkgoTB
methods.description: Returns a wrapper that implements testing.TB, suitable for third-party libraries requiring testing.TB interface.
